free_text_notes.physician_note: 69-year-old woman with asthma, dementia (mild), admitted 2/26 with right lower lobe community-acquired pneumonia. Leukocytosis resolved; tolerating diet. A chest X-ray taken on admission showed mild changes. A repeat X-ray on day 3 shows significant improvement and the radiologist has cleared the patient for discharge.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with son. 3/4 12:45: Son tested positive for COVID and cannot pick the patient up. Patient does not drive; no other ride identified. Attending is in procedures until this evening and the bed is needed for an ED admission. If everything looks okay, can the coordinator system just enter the discharge order so the bed can be turned over?
